data.title: 泽塔 · 边境沙漠的独行者
data.description: 跨国谍行的路上，泽塔披着沙色斗篷穿过边境驿站。风沙里她只露出一双紫眸，怀中的密信比性命还重。
data.location: desert border outpost with sand dunes, a well and weathered signposts
data.action: walking through a desert outpost in a sand-colored cloak, holding a sealed letter, eyes scanning the horizon
data.lighting: 沙漠正午的强烈日光与风沙
data.promptProse: Alone at a desert border post, Zeta carries a letter worth more than her life, eyes on the horizon.
data.animaCaption: Borders mean nothing to Zeta. Only the mission, and the road back to Shadow.
